scope: Exact declared observer reductions and experiment-specific provenance; physical calibration is separately evidenced

exact_serialization.printed_values: original decimal string with source precision retained

evidence_authentication: Trusted payloads and nested source records are compared in their canonical JSON representation; booleans, integers and strings are not interchangeable

correction_binding.ownership: observation_id must identify the observation receiving the correction; moving a correction to another observation requires new trusted evidence

nuclear_observation_binding.scope: The enclosing observation context is bound to the separately validated event source; standalone event timing fields and numerical reductions are unchanged

requirements: independent reference realization and observation map

apparatus_profiles.hydrogen: continuous maser heterodyne and source-bound correction chain
apparatus_profiles.cesium: driven fountain, two interactions, calibrated fluorescence population estimator

invariants: whole artifact replay for every native-linked product
observer passivity and no future cut access
source aggregates excluded when their components already enter same budget
no packet/cycle/closure identification without observation map
limits: No independent atomic frequency from SI normalization
No nuclear kernel or lifetime fit
No promotion of printed-input replay to raw experiment reproduction
No new awareness, path-integral or universal complexity premise

comparison_assessment.compatibility: Schema family and numerical laws are unchanged. Contract version 2 requires observation-specific correction evidence and an authenticated enclosing nuclear observation context, and rejects type-mismatched evidence or malformed comparison metadata previously accepted. Fully bound records retain their numerical results
comparison_assessment.authentication: Complete assessment declaration and endpoint quantities are separately bound to supplied trusted sources using canonical JSON equality
comparison_assessment.count_endpoints: native_reclosure_count and shed_packet_event require nonnegative integral values on both sides: JSON integers or canonical integer strings accepted by exact(); boolean, float, negative, fractional and noncanonical representations are rejected. The native observation extractor still requires a JSON integer
comparison_assessment.evaluation_method: Type_A and Type_B describe methods of uncertainty evaluation, not random or systematic error classes
comparison_assessment.condition_transfer: An applied effect inferred at a different location requires independently bound transfer scope; an external ambient field is not the internal apparatus field
comparison_assessment.windows: Observation cuts retain coordinate and epoch; a separately declared reflection duration has its own nonblank string coordinate and unit, with no implicit observation or SI map
comparison_assessment.dependency_identity: Shared source payload digests remain shared under identifier aliases; absence of detected overlap does not establish independence
comparison_assessment.materiality: A bound below a positive tolerance requires authenticated influence, window, coordinate, epoch and common output unit; it does not certify a complete physical budget
comparison_assessment.arithmetic: Exact supplied prediction minus supplied comparison; previously applied corrections are never applied again
limits: No inferred probability distribution or physical acceptance score
No certification of independent physical validation
Unknown residual uncertainty and applicability remain explicit

external_quantities.authentication: The separately supplied trusted store binds canonical quantity kind, unit, dimension, admissible domain/window, locator, role, value meaning, uncertainty category, components and correction ownership. The uncertainty model binds every quantity identity and parameter, expressions, route and complete uncertainty inputs.

routes.finite_joint_law: Exact named joint atom evaluation, means and full cross-output covariance; only a declared finite law may take this route.
routes.moments: Supplied means and complete PSD covariance. Affine outputs and their covariance are exact conditional moments. Nonlinear output uncertainty remains partial beyond its linearized diagnostic.
routes.bounds: Conditional rational interval enclosure; source intervals and expression denominator domains are checked. No probability law inferred.
routes.metadata: Preserve the source value, printed uncertainty token and category when covariance, coverage or transformation is insufficient.

external_quantities.conversion: An explicit conversion executes its source-bound exact scale using the declared input and output coordinate units. Unit labels alone cannot convert numbers. An uncertain parameter must enter as an uncertain input, never as an exact parameter.
external_quantities.dependence: Payload aliases retain one source/quantity identity; aggregates cannot be used with their own components. All outputs share one authenticated input model and retain joint covariance when supported.
external_quantities.budgets: Every output retains arithmetic, resolution, window, model_discrepancy, calibration, propagation, solver and comparison. Propagated variance is exact rational with a squared-unit descriptor and symbolic square root; a bound is an interval, never a standard deviation. included_in_propagation is a reference, not an additional component to add. This result budget is distinct from the legacy map-budget v2 serialization.
external_quantities.comparison: Prediction propagation rejects evaluation-role quantities. Comparison propagation preserves evaluation role and supplied joint dependence; it does not assert independent validation.
external_quantities.corrections: Source correction ownership and included_in_input status remain attached to the quantity. This dispatcher never applies a correction.
external_quantities.compatibility: Existing API signatures and numerical laws are retained. Legacy validate_error_dependencies fixtures without quantity payloads remain declared synthetic typing, not authenticated experimental typing; when a trusted quantity payload exists its unit, dimension and uncertainty kind must match. New external usage requires the versioned binding. Distinct source-role wrappers can refer to the same parent paper or primary-file hash; each quantity remains individually named and the joint model retains actual dependence. Mixed calibration/evaluation roles are not packed into one source-role wrapper.
limits: Conditional propagation does not establish empirical adequacy or a physical realization budget
A source hash establishes binding, not truth
No inferred normality, missing covariance, coverage factor, independent copy or universal clock
Published measurement reduction is not raw stream replay
external_quantities.primary_sources: load_primary_receipt(name) authenticates archived PDF bytes and a fixed transcription receipt separately from historical protocol bytes; published aggregate standard uncertainty can enter the conditional affine moment route without inventing component covariance.
